If you need a heating and cooling company please use them. They will do the best for you and your family.

They gave me a good deal on the maintenance and the refrigerant top off as well as expectations for potential future repairs/replacement. They're my new go-to for needs.

From day one they have been transparent, understanding, knowledgeable, respectful, kind, and explanatory on the problem with my ac. They have kept me informed and willing to work with my situation. They are faithful and good stewards. Thank You Honest Abe!

OUTSTANDING QUALITY!!! I cannot speak good enough words that will suffice how good I felt about having Honest Abe take care of me. I have a membership with A#1 Air and Honest Abe beat them at every front.
Thank you.

Really appreciated the knowledge and experience.  Technician stayed until he found and repaired the problem.  I’ve referred him to some neighbors and also my daughter who is a real estate agent for Ebby.  She will refer ya’ll!

Five stars for Mr. Orlando he was on time, diagnosed the problem in mins, came and went over my options, once we agreed on what’s best he went to work and knocked it out in less than an hour. I was already discussing what hotel for tonight and he had it done before we could pick one. Please see that Orlando gets an at-a-boy from this customer!!!
Great service from start to finish! Called to make an appointment and the girl I talked to was helpful and kind. Then our service tech Phillip was also helpful and kind. Great job and thank you!!
Amazing help walked us through the whole process of what and why and did not look to Nickle and Dime us on the repair. Phil was awesome. Got it done, quick, very polite and professional.

Today I called Honest Abes and within 30 minutes someone was at my house working on my ac unit.  The guys were professional,  helpful and very quick and determining what the issue was.  Most of all was the great price they give me . I will highly recommend that you use them for any of your services

Everyone I’ve interacted with here has been great and super nice to boot. It was easy to call and schedule a service. The technician made recommendations of preventative maintenance and had the data to support his recommendations. Having everything handled and wrapped up in one trip by a knowledgeable and friendly service technician was just exactly what I had in mind for my pre-summer AC service. Thank you.

These guys are fantastic!   We have been using Honest Abe for several years now. Phil was on time, very courteous and knowledgeable in his work.  Did not try to hard-pressure upsell or sell something that wasn’t needed. Would highly recommend Honest Abe Comfort Solutions and Phil for your HVAC needs!

Truly an amazing company! Not only is the price highly competitive but the customer service is the best in the business. They explained everything in great detail about what kind of AC upgrade we needed and how we can benefit the most from the new system. Highly recommend Honest Abe to anyone looking for a new AC or needing a tune up. An awesome company ran by honest people. I’d give 10 stars if it was allowed.
Phillip was quick and very professional. Marissa did a great job scheduling the appointment at the last minute for us.

They show pictures of all of the readings, explain them in detail to me and let me know if anything should be done and why. Honest Abe comfort solutions practices what they preach and honesty is their practice willing to explain AC issues taking their time to listen to the customer and so honest down to earth !!! I wouldnt think twice to call them again in the future for my  AC issues …. Very effective service thank you Abe!!!

Great customer service, from the gentlam that answered my call for scheduling, to the one who came and provided the service. Very efficient and informative.

***For sure will reuse services and recommend to friends and family***
